paragraphs.text: Pol Jamaar , Illusionist , is a human illusion wizard from an unknown plane.

Pol Jamaar is a human wizard, who himself is actually an illusion. It is not known what plane he comes from but he is possibly Dominarian . He appears as a light skinned, blue haired human wearing white and blue clothes. Pol wields a golden staff and is sometimes seen with blue magical wings coming out of his back.
